cases.question: List each author occurrence and publication whose author is affiliated with a Canadian university.
cases.sql: SELECT a.name, p.title FROM WROTE AS w JOIN AUTHOR AS a ON w.author_aid = a.aid JOIN UNIVERSITY AS u ON a.uni_id = u.uid JOIN PAPER AS p ON w.paper_pid = p.pid WHERE u.country = 'CA';
cases.sqlp: SELECT w.author.name, w.paper.title FROM WROTE w WHERE w.author.university.country = 'CA';

cases.question: Which distinct authors have a publication whose publisher is based in Denmark?
cases.sql: SELECT DISTINCT a.name FROM WROTE AS w JOIN AUTHOR AS a ON w.author_aid = a.aid JOIN PAPER AS p ON w.paper_pid = p.pid JOIN UNIVERSITY AS u ON p.publisher_uid = u.uid WHERE u.country = 'DK';
cases.sqlp: SELECT DISTINCT w.author.name FROM WROTE w WHERE w.paper.publisher.country = 'DK';

cases.question: For every author, list their name and their mentor's mentor's name.
cases.sql: SELECT a.name, m2.name FROM AUTHOR AS a JOIN AUTHOR AS m1 ON a.mentor_aid = m1.aid JOIN AUTHOR AS m2 ON m1.mentor_aid = m2.aid;
cases.sqlp: SELECT a.name, a.mentor.mentor.name FROM AUTHOR a;
